purpose: Replace pre-execution placeholder aliases with the user-supplied anonymous role assignments before E1 blind-review package generation.

supersedes_for_packet_generation_only.reason: The prior lock recorded placeholder aliases before the physical 315-run collection; it remains preserved as historical administration evidence.

reviewer_A.user_attested_background: 社会急救方向受训人员；完成红十字体系急救理论与全套实操课程；长期参与院前第一目击者急救模拟、创伤处置和急症应急施救训练。
reviewer_A.scope: 公众急救情景文本的结构化输出审核；不从事临床诊断、处方或个体化诊疗。

reviewer_B.user_attested_background: 具备救护员急救训练背景；红十字会初级救护员证书（用户陈述：有效期3年且目前有效）；2年急救情景文本结构化判断相关工作。
reviewer_B.scope: 仅依据冻结协议、标签手册和受控本体做标注型科研辅助工作；不接触真实病患，不开展临床诊断或输出诊疗方案。

adjudication_body_C.scope: 对分歧的证据适用性、公众急救边界、跨灾种错配和高风险动作作最终结构化裁决；不替代临床执业或真实个案医疗决策。
adjudication_body_C.additional_accountability_before_first_a: 联合机构在Git外记录实际参与裁决的负责人员/授权方式；该私有记录不得放入A/B审阅包或公开仓库。

independence_and_blinding: ANN-A and ANN-B must be different people and work independently.
ANN-A and ANN-B may not see each other's packet, progress, labels, summaries, configuration, energy, run_order, run_key or crosswalk.
ANN-C-ORG receives A/B records only after both packets are locked and integrity-checked.
The configuration/energy crosswalk remains host-and-adjudication-body only and never enters a reviewer-visible repository or package.
completion_rule: 315 completed A records + 315 completed B records + every disagreement adjudicated, with no unresolved schema or blind-integrity failure.
